# Nimble | Product Overview

Nimble is a light mass of CRM with relationships nurtured, contacts enriched and Microsoft 365/Google Workspace at its core. The product core builds a unified workspace around customer relations, sales implementation and revenue processes, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
